data.title: 1H 2024 Transparency Report Statistics
data.content:
Kakao has not provided communication data since the first half of 2013.
In response to requests for data on communication-restricting measures in Daum services, only data that strictly pertain to standards are provided after thorough review is conducted in accordance to relevant legislations. We do not provide any data on communication-restricting measures that pertain to Kakao services.
The number of requests for communication confirmation data and processed requests related to Daum services has increased by 2.7% and 22.6%, respectively, compared to the second half of 2023. Meanwhile, the number of requests and processed requests related to Kakao services has increased slightly over the same period.
Requests for search and seizure warrants related to Daum services have decreased slightly compared to the second half of 2023, while those for Kakao services have increased slightly over the same period.
Kakao strives to provide only the minimum information necessary to meet the requirements.
